outcome: Duration to the hearing of intestinal sounds
cohort: The study included 90 women (45 in the experimental group and 45 in the control group) who underwent cesarean delivery under spinal anesthesia.
finding: Sugar-free gum chewing in the post-operative period following cesarean section under spinal anesthesia significantly shortened the duration of intestinal movement, the time of first flatulation, and discharge time.
followup_time: Observations were taken in the immediate postoperative period, with specific outcomes measured up to approximately 26 hours after surgery for flatulation.
